ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Kinetic Arms
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
A family of ancient kinetic-blast weapons whose shots throw people rather than wound them. Built on Explosive Knockback.
- Thudder grenade: a thrown concussion grenade that clears a doorway. - Palm thumper: a sidearm that shoves one target straight away from the shooter. - Slam launcher: a lobbed kinetic charge for the enemy's second rank. - Repulsor rifle: every hit pushes the target back along the shot line. - Kicker mine: a buried, rotatable plate that launches whoever steps on it in its facing, and re-arms with chemfuel. - Thump shell: a wide, low-damage throwing shell for the ordinary mortar. - Pulse cannon: a powered turret that stores pulse charges and shoves raiders away from your wall. - Grav-ram: the strongest throw there is.
Also: the mechanoid thump cannon now throws farther than a mortar shell beside its impact.
Kinetic blasts do little or no wound damage and barely scratch walls. They kill only through what they throw you into: walls, pits, fire, other people.
These weapons are not crafted: they are found. Every weapon and the thump cannon change has a Mod Settings toggle; all off leaves the items inert in the world and the thump cannon vanilla. Design: design/RimMandrake/kinetic_blast_weapons_design_2026-10-06.md.
